projects.title: E-commerce & Enterprise Tools
tasks: Planned and executed the strategic migration of main frontend platforms from Angular to Next.js/React, while collaborating with product leadership to refactor legacy systems for higher scalability.
Streamlined local development workflows by dockerizing backend services and creating automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins and OpenShift.
Partnered with backend teams to redesign API endpoints and optimize data exchange, significantly improving overall system performance and developer experience (DX).
Improved Core Web Vitals (CLS and FCP) and resolved Server-Side Rendering (SSR) bottlenecks by replacing heavy JavaScript rendering logic with clean, efficient SCSS.
Upgraded project infrastructure across Angular versions while enforcing strict SonarQube code quality standards.
Supervised junior developers and established automated testing protocols with Jasmine and Cypress to ensure code coverage.
Partnered closely with international product teams, UI/UX designers, and managers to deliver accessible features and integrate third-party solutions like Cookiebot and Google Tag Manager.

projects.title: Full Stack GIS & Analytics Platform
tasks: Led the architectural refactoring of a high-throughput geospatial analytics platform built on Angular, optimizing data manipulation routines for spatial layers and spatial reporting using Leaflet.
Designed scalable state management and reactive data streams using RxJS and GraphQL to power real-time, responsive dashboard interfaces.
Authored automated scripts to monitor microservice health and maintain continuous operational uptime for backend services and GeoServer instances.
Re-architected monolithic codebases into lazy-loaded feature modules to optimize load times, while conducting code reviews to ensure strict quality standards across engineering teams.

projects.title: Full Stack Fitness App
tasks: Designed and built a full-stack fitness tracking web application from scratch using Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and an Angular frontend styled with Material UI.
Modeled relational database schemas, configured Prisma ORM migrations, and implemented RESTful APIs to manage asynchronous user data and workout analytics.

projects.title: Responsive Web Application
tasks: Designed, developed, and deployed a fully responsive web application following product owner specifications, utilizing HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript.

projects.title: Technical Project Management
tasks: Managed field engineering teams of 4 to 6 technicians through full project life cycles, handling cross-functional communication, risk mitigation strategies, and stakeholder negotiations.
